Presales for the game were at $1.65 billion as of Wednesday. The previous installment has sold nearly 230 million copies and generated $10.78 billion of revenue since its 2013 launch.

tech.title: Apple Is Working on AI Agent for Device Control, Apps, Browsing and Coding
tech.summary: Apple is developing an autonomous AI agent that can get things done on behalf of users similar to offerings by OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, and others. The company is currently seeking a senior engineering manager for a proactive, agentic AI assistant that can write code, browse the web, control apps, and navigate devices on a user's behalf. Apple is working on agents that can plan and carry out multi-step tasks across apps, browsers, command lines, code, and APIs while coordinating specialized subagents along the way. The company's App Store has been dominated by AI agents, so it has introduced a new warning in the upcoming macOS 27.3 update that prompts users to reconsider granting third-party agents permission to control their Macs.

tech.title: Spacecraft reaches Mercury on second-ever mission to enter its orbit
tech.summary: The BepiColombo mission is now preparing to swing into orbit around Mercury. The joint European-Japanese space mission aims to help scientists understand how Mercury formed so close to the Sun, why it has a magnetic field, and what makes up the frozen ice under the planet's permanently shadowed craters. The spacecraft will separate into two orbiters in early December. The orbiters will maneuver to different polar orbits around the planet, and science operations will begin in April next year.

tech.title: Google turns to Blue Origin for a rocket, but its long-term problem remains

Google's Project Suncatcher program is a long-term moonshot that aims to scale AI infrastructure in space by tapping into solar power. Its satellites each have the computing capacity of roughly the scale of a data center rack. The mission on New Glenn will deploy satellites into a Sun-synchronous orbit, where they will be able to receive nearly continuous solar energy.

tech.title: PostgreSQL 19 Released!
tech.summary: PostgreSQL 19 simplifies both administration and development for mission-critical workloads at scale. The release introduces the `REPACK (CONCURRENTLY)` command, which enables users to optimize tables for their current workload without disruption to ongoing operations. It also gives users better control over plan stability and query performance with the new pg_plan_advice extension. PostgreSQL 19 gives users new ways to manage their workloads without disruption and build applications that span multiple systems.

tech.title: The most important number in AI
tech.summary: The Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI) is a measure of AI progress developed by Epoch AI, a nonprofit research organization. It provides a single number that summarizes how well AI models do on benchmarks. It is designed to be continuously updatable, and researchers can use it to look at trends going back years and forecast things for future models. This post covers how the ECI is constructed, the challenges of benchmark selection, whether it makes sense to talk about 'model IQ', whether static benchmarks stay relevant as models get better, and much more.

webdev.title: Distributed, High-Performance Blob Storage on SQLite

In a memory-backed benchmark with 64 KiB JSON payloads, moving from one shard to 16 raised write throughput from about 7,700 to 25,300 operations per second. Cluster slots are configured statically, with offline resharding and no automatic failover.

webdev.title: Top 10 Things AI Gets Wrong in Web Development

webdev.title: When Can You Ship on Offline Evals Alone?

In its working example, measurement noise makes the offline eval appear to explain 24% of the variance in online effects when the modeled value is 60%. The proposed rule sends borderline changes to A/B tests and randomly audits some other decisions to detect drift.

webdev.title: Why Chrome Still Uses the Old IP After You Edit Your Hosts File
webdev.summary: Chrome can reuse a connection to the old IP after a hosts file edit because it pools connections by hostname and port. A used socket can stay open for five idle minutes, and flushing Chrome's socket pools forces a fresh lookup but also closes unrelated connections in the same profile.

devops.title: CVE-2026-114938 OpenJDK RCE (Java4Shell): Everything You Need to Know
devops.summary: CVE-2026-114938 is a critical 9.2 severity RCE vulnerability in OpenJDK's AVX-512 Base64 decoding that causes heap memory corruption. It affects OpenJDK 17.0.6 and later on x86-64 hardware and enables pre-auth RCE in applications like Jenkins, Confluence, and Tomcat. Users should upgrade OpenJDK or disable Base64 intrinsics immediately.

Costco is benefiting, with US comparable sales rising an estimated 11% to 12% in the final week of October compared with its typical 6% to 7% growth. Momentum continued into November as 21 of 26 generators tracked on Costco's website sold out. Sam's Club and home improvement retailers are also seeing increased demand.

Burger King releases only 110 calendars a day, so fans follow the drop before the doors even open. Red Bull added one pack-exclusive flavor that has fans debating whether to buy the whole box for it.

marketing.title: Make Them Type the Promo Code: Why a Little Effort Beats an Automatic Discount in Digital Shopping
marketing.summary: Requiring customers to enter a promo code can generate more sales than automatically applying the same discount. A study found that a 15% discount redeemed through a promo code converted at 1.45%, compared with 0.91% for an automatic discount. The small action makes customers feel like they earned the deal, increasing their sense of value and likelihood of redeeming it. The tactic works best for modest discounts of 10% to 15%, but the effort should remain minimal. Additional steps can create frustration and eliminate the benefit.

marketing.title: When influencers post sponsored content, your brand should...

Have your social team comment on sponsored posts, reply to every comment, involve public-facing employees, share posts to Instagram Stories, and use reposts and tagged content to feature creator posts on your brand profile. For campaigns with multiple influencers, send creators links to each other's posts and encourage them to engage. Discuss these tactics with creators beforehand so everyone understands their role in promoting the partnership.

Catalyst Brands is investing in loyalty programs to strengthen direct customer relationships across brands like JC Penney and Brooks Brothers.

marketing.title: PayPal Said Honey Followed Last-Click Attribution, Which Was the Whole Problem
marketing.summary: Last-click attribution can overstate the performance of advertising channels that capture sales rather than generate them. This is especially common in brand search, retargeting, coupon extensions, cart abandonment emails, and affiliate marketing. A 2015 eBay study found that turning off paid search ads had no significant impact on sales, even though attribution reports credited those ads with strong returns. Run incrementality tests to measure actual sales lift, exclude brand searches from automated campaigns, and revise affiliate terms to limit commissions for partners that only capture credit at checkout.

marketing.title: Sam Altman warns against a future where AI, not humans, calls the shots
marketing.summary: Sam Altman and Greg Brockman oppose the idea of gradually handing control of society to AI as models become more powerful. Both believe humans must remain in charge but differ on how to prevent an accidental or intentional handover. Brockman stressed the growing need for better AI monitoring and security as models become harder to track through traditional chain-of-thought monitoring. Following a security breach, OpenAI redirected 25% of production engineers to security work.
